guards.population: Every newly reachable object in the exact target and every retained ancestor relative to the supplied published baseline
Every newly reachable object of each accepted step, including synthesized transport trees and commits
Complete final transport ancestry relative to the published baseline

syntax.method: ast.parse only; neither original nor adapted planner imported or executed

limits: This is a prospective source/AST review, not a behavioral planner run or a server probe.
The archived prior 4B script is preserved for provenance only and must not be executed from planning/.

No parent, tree or history contract is relaxed. If the finalized target still retains an oversized unpublished 5A object, planning must fail. Root must first construct the intended clean final integration from the actual published predecessor.
No planner invocation is authorized before the final 4B cost window and independent publication prerequisites pass, and the completed checkout is committed and clean.
The passed-window guard does not itself recalculate the global cost budget or prove the supplied baseline was published.
Forty MiB raw aggregate bytes and the new 32 MiB individual ceiling are distinct limits; raw byte size does not guarantee actual network pack size.

Future planner execution writes local Git objects and an exclusive JSON outside the checkout but preserves HEAD, refs, real index, worktree and remote. Only later authorized ordinary Sites helper pushes may transport the result.
